subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) And with that he threw it back into the rivers and watched it swim away. (b) The battle continued. (c) Then the man who caught it said, "It is very beautiful. Let it go." (d) The fish was very large and was fighting harder than before. (e) Its gills opened and closed as if it were tired from the light. (f) All the men on the bank stared at the fish for a moment. (g) The fisher tried to pull it in but the fish didn't give up. (h) One day some fishermen were trying to catch the giant bluefish, the talk of the town.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
